page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 2 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average single-core performance, as seen in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests. However, multi-core scaling is relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25% for multi-core CPU benchmarks and software compilation. Memory bandwidth tests also show weaker throughput, with large-block read and write speeds falling into the lower quartile, though Passmark memory scores remain in the average tier.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource profile, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads such as lightweight web serving, text processing, and basic database operations that do not require high-throughput multi-threaded scaling. From a cost-efficiency perspective, it offers a standard entry-level dedicated resource profile without the premium cost of memory-optimized or storage-heavy instances, though workloads requiring high memory bandwidth or local NVMe storage will face performance tradeoffs.
